name: How do I compare luxury pool bids fairly?

mainEntity.name: What should I compare in contractor bids so I can tell which luxury pool quote is actually better?
mainEntity.text: What should I compare in contractor bids so I can tell which luxury pool quote is actually better?

acceptedAnswer.text: The best way to compare luxury pool bids is to look beyond total price and examine what each contractor is actually including. A fair comparison should cover excavation, structural shell, plumbing, electrical, finishes, tile, coping, decking, equipment, automation, permit coordination, and cleanup. It is also important to check exclusions, allowances, and assumptions because a low bid may leave out items that become expensive change orders later. Equipment brands and finish levels matter because they affect durability and performance, not just appearance. Homeowners should also compare schedule expectations, warranty terms, and who manages inspections and communication. A strong bid is detailed enough that you can see where the money is going. The goal is not simply to find the lowest number, but to identify the most complete and realistic proposal.
acceptedAnswer.description: Compare the scope, materials, equipment brands, finish quality, permit handling, engineering, exclusions, and contingency assumptions, not just the bottom-line price. The cheapest quote is often missing important items that become change orders later.
